The americano is

slides.body:
Koreans price a cafe by one drink. The americano is what goes on the sign, what gets compared between chains, and what makes the news when it moves — so it is the last line on the menu anyone touches.

Everything around it is fair game. The Venti raised about a dozen drinks and topping options at the end of May and left the americano where it was. Mega MGC added 200 won to three Hal-Mega drinks on 19 June and left the americano where it was. Pascucci raised 31 items this month and held the regular americano at 4,700 won.

The result is a menu that reads as cheap as it did last year and costs more to order from.

slides.cta:
Order the americano.
Save this for the rest

caption:
Korea's cheap-coffee era did not end this year. It ended in 2025 — and 2026 has been quietly taking everything you would add to the cup.

The input cost first. In June the Korea Customs Service put the import price of coffee at 40,083 won a kilo, up 19.6% on the year and the sixth straight month of double-digit rises; in February it was 34,505. The beans themselves have actually cooled — aT's average arabica price was 7,301 dollars a tonne in July against a two-year peak of 8,990 in November 2025 — but a won sitting near 1,500 to the dollar keeps the landed cost climbing anyway.

What the chains did with that is the interesting part. The americano is the drink Koreans price a cafe by, so it is the last line anyone touches. The Venti raised about a dozen drinks and toppings at the end of May and left the americano alone: its Icheon rice latte went 2,800 to 3,300 won, a large oat or decaf swap 800 to 1,000. Mega MGC added 200 won to three Hal-Mega drinks on 19 June and left the americano alone. Pascucci raised 31 drinks and cakes this month by an average of 4.9% — roughly 1.7 times September's 2.9% inflation — and held the regular americano at 4,700 won.

So the menu reads as cheap as it did last year and costs more to order from. If you are ordering by price here, order the americano; the increase went into the cold brew, the topping and the seasonal cup.

Where the floor sits: Mammoth took its small iced americano from 1,200 to 1,400 won on 11 August, still the lowest of the big chains. Mega MGC went 1,500 to 1,700 on the hot americano back in April 2025, its first move in ten years. Compose went 1,500 to 1,800 on the iced in February 2025. Those are the prices each chain announced; franchise menus vary by store and size, so read the board.

Sources on the last slide. Research, not a visit, and no cafe recommended here.
